_how: TODD's monologue before the fight. Each line is typed out while his screen shows the pictures in 'show' (one after another, if there's more than one). 'pose' is what his body does: palm, rage, preach or look. 'shake' is a word in the line that shakes the screen when it's typed. 'secs' is how long the line stays. Pictures are loaded from Wikimedia while the page runs (never copied into the repo); the first URL is tried, then the next. 'fire' is drawn in code. The last line leads straight into him noticing you.

lines.text: I had the world in the palm of my hands.
It was stolen from me, taken from me, CANCELLED FROM ME!
Life, death, afterlife. VARANDIA COMES BACK, ALWAYS!
